description: Give a sketch region a wall thickness instead of a solid depth.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

midplane.description: Grow symmetrically about the sketch plane.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Thicken").

op.description: NEW makes a new body; ADD/REMOVE/INTERSECT combine with existing bodies (default NEW).

sketch.description: Feature id of the sketch to thicken.

thickness_variable.description: Use a Part Studio variable for the thickness.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_thicken
title: Thicken a sketch
